title: Measures to Reduce Traffic Accidents Involving Animals in Mandai Area
what_it_is: Measures to Reduce Traffic Accidents Involving Animals in Mandai Area

sections.label: Mandai developer impact mitigation duties
sections.summary: Mandai Park Development, a private developer, assessed impacts on flora and fauna and implemented measures to mitigate wildlife impact and reduce roadkill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The current construction work in Mandai is being carried out by Mandai Park Development (MPD), which is a private developer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As with all developments near nature reserves, MPD was required to assess the potential impact of their works on the flora and fauna in the area prior to beginning construction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: MPD is also responsible for implementing measures to mitigate the impact of their development works on wildlife in the area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: MPD has since undertaken a number of measures to reduce roadkill in the area.

sections.label: MPD roadkill reduction measures
sections.summary: MPD put in place a rope bridge for arboreal animals and vehicle speed reduction measures including warning signs, speed bumps and a lowered speed limit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Other measures that MPD has put in place include a rope bridge to help arboreal animals cross the road safely, and vehicle speed reduction measures, such as warning signs, speed bumps and a lowered speed limit.

sections.label: Environmental Management and Monitoring Plan
sections.summary: After planning approval, MPD implements an EMMP monitored and reviewed by an Environmental Advisory Panel with experts from science, academia, nature groups and the private sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Following planning approval, MPD implements an Environmental Management and Monitoring Plan (EMMP) to ensure that mitigation measures are being carried out during the Mandai Rejuvenation Project's development and operations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The EMMP is monitored and reviewed by an Environmental Advisory Panel which includes subject matter experts from the scientific community, academia, nature groups and the private sector.

sections.label: No penalties stated
sections.summary: Based on the speaker's understanding, there are no penalties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Based on my understanding, there are no penalties.
